summary.engine: Athena Static AST / Tree-sitter / Diff Engine

scenarios.description: Renaming a public function is breaking because external callers will raise NameError/AttributeError.
Adding a parameter without a default value breaks existing callers passing positional/keyword args.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Detected added required parameter breaking change: ["Added required parameter(s) ['timeout'] without default values to 'fetch_data'."]

scenarios.description: Removing an optional or required parameter breaks callers explicitly supplying that argument.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Detected parameter removed breaking change: ["Removed parameter(s) ['timeout'] from 'connect' without *args/**kwargs absorption."]

scenarios.description: Adding an optional parameter with default is backward-compatible and should NOT trigger a breaking change.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Correctly classified as non-breaking optional addition (is_breaking=False).

scenarios.description: Changing default to None without guard raises runtime TypeError (val + 5 fails if None). Must be flagged.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Flagged unguarded default=None change as breaking: ["Default value for parameter 'val' in 'process' changed from 10 to None."]

scenarios.description: Changing default to None WITH body fallback guard (if val is None) is safe; should NOT flag as breaking.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Correctly identified guard and marked non-breaking (is_breaking=False).

scenarios.description: Changing return type from int to str breaks downstream typed consumers and type checkers.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Flagged return type change as breaking: ["Return type annotation of 'get_user_id' changed from 'int' to 'str'."]

scenarios.description: Raising an unhandled ValueError breaks callers that do not catch it (documented griffe#498 limitation).
scenarios.mode_a_details: Flagged new exception as breaking: ["Function 'parse_record' now raises new exception type(s) ['ValueError'] not raised in base revision."]

scenarios.description: Changing method signature in base class breaks overriding subclasses.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Flagged base class method signature change: ["Added required parameter(s) ['ctx'] without default values to 'BaseHandler.handle'."]

scenarios.description: Pure body refactor with identical signature and return type must produce ZERO breaking changes.
scenarios.mode_a_details: Zero false positive breaking changes detected (is_breaking=False).
